Daredevil Pedals is a small-batch, handmade pedal company operating out of Chicago, IL. The Ten Tone Anniversary Fuzz celebrates their milestone with expanded features. The Ten Tone Anniversary Fuzz builds on Daredevil's fuzz expertise with added EQ control for greater tonal flexibility. The larger enclosure accommodates the additional tone-shaping circuitry. Hand-wired in Chicago using quality components. Features true bypass switching. The anniversary edition represents a special release in their catalog. Runs on 9V battery or DC power supply. Demo Videos Specifications Power 9V DC Current Draw ~50mA est.
